stage.instructions: In `log_excerpt` from a GitHub Actions run, at which stage did the first failure happen?

criteria.setup: Runner, toolchain or package installation before any repository command
criteria.format_or_module: Formatting, module verification or dependency download
criteria.compile: Go or C/C++ compilation or linking
criteria.tests: A Go test assertion, panic or timeout
criteria.build_or_package: Production build, startup check or artifact upload

repository_caused.instructions: Is the first failure in `log_excerpt` caused by repository code or tests rather than by the runner environment or an external service?

criteria.true: Caused by repository code or tests
criteria.false: Caused by environment, package mirror, version pin or external service
